facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that the Central Bank of eSwatini has launched an e-KYC registry, a centralised platform that lets commercial banks, financial institutions and certain public administrations electronically verify client identities.

systems.country_label: Central Bank of eSwatini e-KYC system

SWZ.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the national ID system.
The e-KYC registry is a verification service for banks; no public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
The national ID system itself is not described.
No civil registration system is mentioned.
